option.mapsyncer.hash_threads.tooltip: Parallel threads used when scanning local map files and reading cached version info before sync. Higher values may speed up preparation but increase CPU usage.
option.mapsyncer.debug.tooltip: When enabled, detailed map generation debug information will be output to the log.
option.mapsyncer.concurrent_regions.tool: Maximum number of regions converted simultaneously. 0 = automatic (CPU cores − 2, clamped to 1–16). Higher values process faster but demand more server CPU.
option.mapsyncer.packet_size.tooltip: Maximum bytes per network packet during sync. Excessively large packets may be dropped on unstable connections.
option.mapsyncer.update_mode.tooltip:
Server-side map cache incremental update strategy.

DISABLED - No incremental updates.
ON_EMPTY - Runs an incremental update whenever no players are online (once per empty period, including after the last player leaves). The client always auto-syncs on join based on the server cache.
